title: Tomato Relish - quick and easy
preamble:
2 small onions, finely chopped

10 small tomatoes, finely chopped

3 cloves garlic

Half green chilli

75 g brown sugar
method: Heat a little oil in a frying pan and cook the onions until softened.
Add the tomatoes, chilli and garlic and mix well, then add the sugar, vinegar and cinnamon and bring to the boil.
Season to taste with Tabasco sauce, salt and pepper and set aside to cool.
